title: A Noetherian complete local domain is finite over a regular complete power series subring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local domain which is $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Then there is a subring $R_0\subseteq R$ with the following properties: (1) $R_0$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_0=\mathfrak m\cap R_0$, which is $\mathfrak m_0$-adically complete; (2) $R$ is a finitely generated $R_0$-module, and the inclusion induces an isomorphism of residue fields $R_0/\mathfrak m_0\xrightarrow{\sim}R/\mathfrak m$; (3) $R_0$ is isomorphic either to a formal power series ring $k[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] over a field $k$, or to $\Lambda[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ over a Cohen ring $\Lambda$, i.e. a discrete valuation ring (a local principal ideal domain which is not a field) that is complete with respect to its maximal ideal and whose maximal ideal is generated by a prime number $p$ (Algebra, Definition 0327).
